description: Clicking the "Arjun Reddy" patient result in header search goes to /dashboard/patients?search=cmw6dbbe2000a7dc1bw0xhc61. The list search box is seeded with the internal id and shows "No patients found" (mapped auth defect #1 / patients #8, confirmed). Pressing Enter does the same, since the first result is the patient.
actual: Empty list with a cuid in the search box; the receptionist has to clear it and search by phone.

description: Searching "shravya" and clicking the staff result takes RECEPTION to /dashboard/users?search=<id>, a page that is not in her sidebar. It ignores the search param and lists every user, including a PATIENT portal account, with "New User", "Clinic Holidays", "Edit", "Delete", "Reset password" and "Role & Permissions" buttons (mapped auth defect #2, confirmed; GET /users has no @Roles).
expected: Staff results are hidden for roles without Users access, or open a read-only profile; the page filters by the param.
actual: The full staff directory and admin controls are exposed to the receptionist.
suggested_fix: Hide user results for non-admin roles in header.tsx; add @Roles to GET /users; add a route guard on /dashboard/users.

description: The appointment result "Arjun Reddy - 10:00-10:30 · 21 Nov 2026" opens bare /dashboard/appointments with Doctor = Praneeta Jain and Date = 11/07/2026 (today), not 21 Nov (mapped auth defect #3 / appointments #19, confirmed).
expected: The link carries doctorId and date (and highlights the appointment).
actual: Riya has to change the date by hand to find the slot.
suggested_fix: href: /dashboard/appointments?doctorId=…&date=…&appointmentId=…, and read those params on the page.

criterion: One way per task / predictable search
description: The phone fragment "543212" finds Arjun's two appointments but not Arjun the patient: patient search is startsWith while appointment search is contains (catalog edge case, confirmed).
expected: The same matching rule for phones everywhere (contains on digits).
actual: Patient missing from results for a phone fragment.

description: The results dropdown has about 30px of empty padding above the first result (visible in every dropdown state), and the footer "Press Enter to go to first result" promises a destination that dead-ends (F-007-01). Search is absent on mobile (see F-001-07).
